mapper.select: select COMPANY_NAME from COMPANY where company_no = #{ companyNo}

SELECT U.USER_NO userNo, U.USER_NAME userName, U.EMAIL email, U.PROFILEIMAGE profileImage, R.RANK_NAME rankName, P.POSITION_NAME positionName, O.ORGANIZATION_NAME organizaionName, C.company_Name companyName FROM USERS U LEFT JOIN TITLE T ON U.USER_NO = T.USER_NO LEFT JOIN RANK R ON T.RANK_NO = R.RANK_NO LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON T.POSITION_NO = P.POSITION_NO LEFT JOIN ORGANIZATION O ON U.USER_NO = O.USER_NO LEFT JOIN COMPANY C ON C.COMPANY_NO = U.COMPANY_NO
WHERE U.COMPANY_NO = #{companyNo}
AND U.USER_NO != #{userNo}
AND U.USER_NO IN ( SELECT ORGMEMBER_NO FROM ORGANIZATIONMEMBER WHERE ORGANIZATION_NO = #{organizationNo} )
AND U.USER_NO IN ( SELECT GRP_MEMBER_NO FROM GROUPSMEMBER WHERE GROUPS_NO = #{groupsNo} )
AND U.USER_NO IN ( SELECT TARGET_NO FROM ADDRBOOKMARK WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} )
AND U.USER_NO IN ( SELECT GRP_MEMBER_NO FROM GROUPSMEMBER WHERE GROUPS_NO IN ( SELECT GROUPS_NO FROM GROUPS WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} ) )
SELECT GROUPS_NO groupsNo, GROUPS_NAME groupsName FROM GROUPS WHERE GROUPS_NO IN (SELECT GROUPS_NO FROM GROUPSMEMBER WHERE GRP_MEMBER_NO = #{ userNo })
SELECT ORGANIZATION_NO organizationNo, ORGANIZATION_NAME organizationName FROM ORGANIZATION WHERE ORGANIZATION_NO IN (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NO FROM ORGANIZATIONMEMBER WHERE ORGMEMBER_NO = #{ userNo })

SELECT u.USER_NO userNo, u.USER_NAME userName, u.PHONENUMBER phoneNumber, g.GROUPS_NAME groupsName, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME organizaionName FROM users u
LEFT JOIN ORGANIZATION o ON u.user_no = o.user_no LEFT JOIN GROUPS g ON u.user_no = g.user_no
WHERE u.USER_NAME LIKE #{pattern} OR u.PHONENUMBER LIKE #{pattern}
OR u.USER_NO IN ( SELECT om.ORGMEMBER_NO FROM ORGANIZATIONMEMBER om JOIN ORGANIZATION org ON om.ORGANIZATION_NO = org.ORGANIZATION_NO WHERE org.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIKE #{pattern} )
OR u.USER_NO IN ( SELECT gm.GRP_MEMBER_NO FROM GROUPSMEMBER gm JOIN GROUPS grp ON gm.GROUPS_NO = grp.GROUPS_NO WHERE grp.GROUPS_NAME LIKE #{pattern} )
